actionConfiguration.body:
UPDATE public."tickets"
SET 
  status = '{{ updatestatus.selectedOptionValue }}',

  file_link = CASE 
    WHEN '{{ updatestatus.selectedOptionValue }}' = 'Completed' THEN '{{ url.text }}'
    WHEN '{{ updatestatus.selectedOptionValue }}' IN ('onProgress', 'Pending') THEN NULL
    ELSE file_link
  END,

  closedat = CASE 
    WHEN '{{ updatestatus.selectedOptionValue }}' = 'Completed' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'
    WHEN '{{ updatestatus.selectedOptionValue }}' IN ('onProgress', 'Pending') THEN NULL
    ELSE closedat
  END,

  time_difference = CASE 
    WHEN '{{ updatestatus.selectedOptionValue }}' = 'Completed' 
    THEN calculate_office_minutes(createdat, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
    ELSE time_difference
  END

WHERE 
  (
    (email = '{{ Tickets.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ Tickets.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
    OR
    (email = '{{ TicketsonProgress.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ TicketsonProgress.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
    OR
    (email = '{{ TicketsCompletedMIS.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedMIS.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
  )OR
    (email = '{{ TicketsCompletedInsights.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedInsights.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
  )
	OR
    (email = '{{ TicketsCompletedDashboard.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedDashboard.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
  )
	OR
	(email = '{{ TicketsCompletedAutomation.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedAutomation.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
  )
	OR
    (email = '{{ TicketsCompletedAI.triggeredRow.email }}' AND ticked_id = '{{ TicketsCompletedAI.triggeredRow.ticked_id }}')
  )
	;
